audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Riven all of levels 1, 4-5, first item and 2+ items and gave Skill to level 6, while the whys say level 1 is 'neither commits', levels 4-5 'stabilize the lane', level 6 is where Feast lands, first item is where you 'own the extended trade', and two items is 'the duel stays even'. diff also reads FAV at 7.5/10, which is self-contradictory, on a 50.77% win rate.
audit.why: Riven's kill pressure lives entirely at levels 2-3, before Carnivore sustain matters. From level 6 Cho'Gath has a true-damage execute and she has no way to crack HP stacking.
audit.corrected: Skill / Riven / Riven / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill — the packet chart — as one atomic group across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side+rating, plus diff EVEN and diffRating 6.5/10 with the two rating rows reworded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase text called Heartsteel the fight-forcing spike and 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' Cho'Gath's window, which is Riven's peak.
audit.why: Her spikes are levels 2-3 with the full Broken Wings chain plus an 11s Ki Burst, and Blade of the Exile at 120s. Yours are level 6 and the first tank component.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) Five fields — spikes[1].text, whys[4], wants.you[2], mid, late — say Feast's true damage 'ignores her E shield'. True damage ignores resistances, not shields; Riot's Valor text says it 'blocks incoming damage' with no exception, and nothing in either kit says Feast bypasses a shield. (2) spikes[0].text, whys[2] and early call the third Broken Wings cast a knockup. Riot's text says it knocks back — the kit's knockup flag disagrees with Riot's own description.
audit.why: A player told Feast ignores Valor will press R into a live shield and lose an 80s ultimate. The correct play is to bait Valor out first, then execute. The knockback-versus-knockup distinction changes where you end up standing after her combo.
audit.corrected: Every 'ignores her E shield' replaced with 'ignores her armour and MR' plus explicit advice to bait Valor first; the third cast described as a knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind'. Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit, and she is not a 'his'.
audit.why: Riot's Riven data carries no heal or lifesteal effect on any of the five abilities. Grievous Wounds is wasted gold in this specific lane.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with armour and HP, which is what actually answers her physical burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was placeholder text with no numbers.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13s covering all three casts, so once she has spent the chain there is a real window; Valor at 10s rank 1 is both her dash and her shield; Ki Burst is 11s.
Packet flagged "Feral Scream's" in wants.you[0] as a suspect name. It is the correct name with a possessive — false positive.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are soft at 1 — she has one Broken Wings cast and no Ki Burst yet, and you have no sustain edge. Set the wave up.

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Riven's Ki Burst is down.
edits.after: Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) is online with her full Broken Wings chain. Give ground and farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Riven must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Her peak — the third Broken Wings cast knocks back into a Ki Burst stun and bursts you before Carnivore matters.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Carnivore sustain and the Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilise the lane; her early kill pressure fades. Farm even.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is true damage that ignores her armour and MR — bait out Valor's shield first, then Rupture into Feral Scream and execute the over-commit.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ki Burst's cooldown.
edits.after: A tank component plus Feast stacks, and her burst combo simply stops killing you.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A fed Riven still one-combos squishies and splitpushes, so peel for your carries rather than chasing the sidelane duel.

edits.before: Q under Riven's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Rupture her as she dashes in, Feral Scream so the rest of Broken Wings and Valor are locked out, then E-spike out.

edits.before: Whiffing Q and fighting anyway — without the knockup your kit is a slow zone with no teeth.
edits.after: Throwing Rupture at max range — she dashes through the wind-up and all-ins the empty cooldown.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Silence after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s at rank 1 — silence the moment she commits, never before it.

edits.before: Q under Riven's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Silencing her mid-combo blanks the remaining Broken Wings casts and the Valor dash — that is the whole early answer.

edits.before: Riven wastes Ki Burst (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Broken Wings is a flat 13s no matter which of its casts she uses.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1 and gives her range too.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Silence after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ki Burst: 11s at rank 1, her stun and combo glue. - Broken Wings: a flat 13s covering all three casts. - Valor: 10s at rank 1, a dash and a shield in one. - Blade of the Exile: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Respect Riven's Ki Burst completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Last-hit with Vorpal Spikes and the edge of Rupture and take the chip. Never throw Q at max range — she dashes through the wind-up. Save Feral Scream for the instant she commits.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ki Burst and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. The lane is decided by whether you keep Feral Scream for her commit instead of poke.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: Track Riven's Ki Burst (Stun): Her engage CC. Silence after it. When it is down — Q-W + R her.
edits.after: Feral Scream mid-combo blanks the rest of Broken Wings and the Valor escape. Ki Burst is 11s.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel  (stacks with Feast forever), then Riftmaker / Thornmail; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel (stacks with Feast forever), then Riftmaker / Thornmail; boots Plated Steelcaps. Skip anti-heal entirely — Riven has no healing in her kit; buy armour and health instead.

edits.before: Riven's biggest window — she has her full Broken Wings (third cast knocks up), Ki Burst stun, and E shield-dash before your Carnivore sustain matters, so she can all-in you off the third-Q knockup into W stun.
edits.after: Riven's biggest window — full Broken Wings (the third cast knocks back), an 11s Ki Burst stun and the Valor shield-dash, all online before Carnivore matters, so she all-ins off the knockback into the stun.

edits.before: Feast comes online — your first real spike, a point-blank true-damage execute that ignores her E shield, armor, and MR, so she can no longer dive you for free and a misjudged all-in just dies to R.
edits.after: Feast comes online — your first real spike, a point-blank true-damage execute that ignores her armour and MR, so bait Valor's shield first and a misjudged all-in simply dies to your R.

edits.after: She bursts you inside the Broken Wings-Ki Burst-Valor combo at 2-3 — third-cast knockback into the stun — before Carnivore can save you; respect the dive.

edits.before: Feast adds a true-damage execute that ignores her E shield, armor, and MR, deterring her all-in and punishing any over-commit dive.
edits.after: Feast adds a true-damage execute that ignores her armour and MR — bait Valor's shield, then punish any over-commit dive with it.

edits.before: Hold Feast for her dive — the true-damage execute ignores her E shield, armor, and MR, so even a full burst combo dies if she over-commits
edits.after: Hold Feast for her dive — true damage ignores her armour and MR, so once Valor's shield is spent a full burst combo still dies to it

notes: The 'ignores her E shield' error also sits in the mid and late prose blocks, which I could not rewrite inside +/-10% without cutting correct advice — they still need a pass. This is worth checking roster-wide: 'true damage ignores shields' is the kind of claim that will have been generated for every shield-owning enemy in Cho'Gath's list, and it is wrong in all of them. NOT ASSERTED: whether a shield absorbs true damage is not stated in Riot's data either way, so I removed the false claim rather than assert the opposite as a mechanic — the replacement text says only 'bait Valor's shield first', which is sound advice regardless of how the interaction resolves. Also not asserted: whether Feral Scream's silence actually prevents the remaining Broken Wings recasts (the existing text claims it and I preserved the claim without strengthening it — a silence stopping an in-progress multi-cast is exactly the kind of thing needsResearch.animationCancels being null means we do not know), and whether Ki Burst is reduced by tenacity.
